description: Multifunctional Cleaning Made Easy: The Bosch Universal Brush is a compact, powerful cleaning tool that helps clean light dirt and stubborn grime. It’s ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, tiles, shoes, garden furniture, and more. Strong Motor for Tough Dirt: Equipped with a high-performance motor, the brush rotates at a steady 215 RPM, delivering constant power for scrubbing tough stains and greasy surfaces. Multiple Attachments for Versatile Use: Comes with various easy-to-swap attachments including a bristle brush, detail brush, pad holder, non-scratch pad, and heavy-duty pad to clean different surfaces like glass, metal, leather, and tile. Cordless and USB Rechargeable: Enjoy the freedom of cordless cleaning. The brush charges via a Micro USB cable and offers hassle-free use with no wires getting in the way. Cleans Hard-to-Reach Areas with Ease: Designed to clean tight spots like taps, shower corners, and narrow joints. The compact design and detail brush make it perfect for deep, targeted cleaning. From scrubbing white sneakers and tyre rims to cleaning ovens, patios, and furniture – this brush is your all-in-one helper for everyday and heavy-duty cleaning.
